title: Voice intent routing
workflow: Caller describes a problem -> transcribe and classify against supported queues -> offer the correct queue or human handoff.
sarvamCapability: Saaras speech recognition; Voice Agents routing
implementationBoundary: The business supplies real queue routing and fallback; never treat guessed urgency as a verified emergency.
saharaReuse: Reuse for routing a non-clinical support request.

title: Dictate a support ticket
workflow: Voice note plus optional order reference -> transcribe and extract issue, device and desired resolution -> show a ticket draft for confirmation.
implementationBoundary: Ticket creation, identity checks and attachments need our backend; retain the original wording beside extracted fields.
saharaReuse: Reuse for an approved help request with fewer form fields.

title: Answer from an approved help centre
workflow: Question plus retrieved help articles -> generate an answer limited to those articles -> return a cited answer or an unanswered-question handoff.
implementationBoundary: We build retrieval, source freshness and citations; a language model does not itself supply an authoritative knowledge base.
saharaReuse: Reuse for app navigation and approved palliative-care education.

title: Carry context into a human handoff
workflow: Consented customer conversation -> extract issue, attempted fixes and unresolved question -> give the human a short handoff card.
implementationBoundary: The receiving agent checks the transcript; generated summaries must not silently drop contradictory facts.
saharaReuse: Reuse for care-team handoffs only after a suitable health-data agreement.

title: Audit calls against a service checklist
workflow: Consented call plus explicit checklist -> diarise and find evidence for each required service step -> produce a review queue with transcript spans.
implementationBoundary: Scores assist a reviewer; they are not proof of staff misconduct or a basis for automatic disciplinary action.
saharaReuse: Reuse for checking consent and communication steps in a supervised pilot.

title: Find repeated service failures
workflow: De-identified tickets and transcripts -> cluster recurring causes and changes over time -> produce a product-fix backlog with examples.
implementationBoundary: Deduplicate records and check categories; generated trend counts must be calculated from actual data outside the model.
saharaReuse: Reuse for prioritising real Sahara usability problems.

title: Extract promises that need follow-up
workflow: Resolved-call transcript -> identify explicit promised actions, owners and dates -> queue unfulfilled commitments for staff review.
implementationBoundary: Do not invent an owner or due date; integration must reconcile promises with the actual ticket state.
saharaReuse: Reuse for a care coordinator's non-clinical follow-up tasks.

title: Guide a repair checklist by voice
workflow: Device model and spoken symptom -> retrieve its approved troubleshooting tree and ask one step at a time -> record completed checks or book a technician.
implementationBoundary: Use a vetted decision tree and stop at electrical or other safety limits; booking is a separate confirmed backend action.
saharaReuse: Reuse the one-question-at-a-time interface, not appliance advice.

title: Check warranty evidence before submission
workflow: Invoice scan, serial number and stated fault -> extract purchase details and compare with the company's warranty rules -> flag missing evidence and prepare the claim.
implementationBoundary: OCR is not document-authenticity verification; a person decides disputed eligibility.
saharaReuse: Reuse the evidence checklist pattern for administrative documents.

title: Qualify a requested callback
workflow: Customer's callback request -> ask the permitted clarifying questions and confirm language and availability -> create a prioritised callback entry.
implementationBoundary: Only call people who requested or otherwise validly consented; our queue supplies the actual callback and retry policy.
saharaReuse: Reuse for scheduling a human callback without asking for a long form.

title: Search a catalogue by speaking needs
workflow: Spoken budget, size and use -> transcribe into catalogue filters and retrieve real inventory -> present a small matching shortlist.
implementationBoundary: Prices, stock and specifications must come from the merchant system; do not invent products.
saharaReuse: Reuse the conversational filtering pattern for a verified centre directory.

title: Build and confirm a voice shopping basket
workflow: Spoken items and quantities -> resolve catalogue IDs and read back ambiguities -> show a basket for explicit confirmation.
implementationBoundary: The app controls item resolution and checkout; no order or charge without an explicit reviewed confirmation.
saharaReuse: Reuse repeat-back confirmation for saved care tasks.

title: Localise product catalogue copy
workflow: Verified source descriptions and brand glossary -> translate and adapt tone -> generate reviewed regional-language catalogue fields.
implementationBoundary: Do not add efficacy, certifications or specifications; native-language review is needed for important product claims.
saharaReuse: Reuse for approved app copy and directory descriptions.

title: Explain a return route from store policy
workflow: Order facts and reason -> retrieve the exact current return policy and apply transparent rules -> explain the required evidence and available return route.
implementationBoundary: Rule execution and refund approval belong to the merchant; ambiguous cases go to staff.
saharaReuse: Reuse policy explanation for account or document support.

title: Read out an authenticated order status
workflow: Verified order reference and question -> query the order system -> speak the actual shipment or fulfilment status.
implementationBoundary: Authentication, tracking data and telephony are external integrations; never use a fluent answer as proof of a delivery.
saharaReuse: Reuse for a real requested visit status if an authorised provider supplies it.

title: Clarify a delivery address
workflow: Spoken address and landmarks -> transcribe into a structured draft and ask about missing components -> return a customer-confirmed address.
implementationBoundary: Sarvam is not a geocoder; map matching and delivery-area validation need a real mapping service and explicit user correction.
saharaReuse: Reuse for confirming a visit location before MapLibre navigation.

title: Compare supplier quotations consistently
workflow: Supplier quotation documents -> extract item, unit, tax and lead-time fields into one schema -> show a comparison with unresolved differences.
implementationBoundary: Calculate totals outside the model and keep original pages; a recommendation is not purchasing authorisation.
saharaReuse: Reuse for comparing equipment donations or procurement quotes.

title: Capture a spoken stocktake
workflow: Shelf item names and spoken counts -> resolve inventory IDs and ask about uncertain units -> create a reviewed stock-count import.
implementationBoundary: Physical counts remain the staff member's evidence; database updates need conflict checks and approval.
saharaReuse: Reuse for tracking centre supplies, not automatically prescribing medicines.

title: Draft grounded replies to customer reviews
workflow: A public review and known resolution facts -> draft an appropriate reply in the reviewer's language -> staff approve and post.
implementationBoundary: Do not invent refunds, contact attempts or personal familiarity; posting remains a deliberate action.
saharaReuse: Reuse for responding to real app feedback.

title: Find purchase-order and invoice mismatches
workflow: Purchase order, goods-received note and invoice -> align extracted lines -> flag quantity, tax and price discrepancies for review.
implementationBoundary: Use deterministic arithmetic and source-linked comparison; no autonomous vendor payment or accusation of fraud.
saharaReuse: Reuse for administrative procurement reconciliation.

title: Turn a meeting into assigned actions
workflow: Consented meeting audio -> separate speakers and extract decisions, open questions and explicit commitments -> publish a reviewed action list.
implementationBoundary: Keep source timestamps. Participants confirm speaker identities, ownership and dates; diarisation labels do not identify people. Recording permission and access controls are separate implementation work.
saharaReuse: Reuse for mentor and team meetings without patient identifiers.

title: Prepare an operational shift handover
workflow: Structured shift logs plus spoken updates -> reconcile completed work and unresolved incidents -> prepare a brief for the incoming shift.
implementationBoundary: Keep source timestamps, outstanding hazards and contradictory reports visible. Confirm speaker and task-owner identity; do not infer a site is safe or assign a commitment from a voice label.
saharaReuse: Reuse for a verified provider-team handover after clinical governance is approved.

title: Explain employee policies with sources
workflow: Question and approved HR policy documents -> retrieve the relevant clause and explain it -> answer with the policy source and HR escalation.
implementationBoundary: No invented entitlement or legal determination; leave approvals and confidential personnel decisions stay with HR.
saharaReuse: Reuse for Sahara organisation onboarding and access policy.

title: Draft a timesheet from a work diary
workflow: Spoken work diary and actual appointment records -> extract activities and durations -> show a timesheet with uncertain periods highlighted.
implementationBoundary: Never fabricate worked hours or attendance; employee approval and payroll rules remain external.
saharaReuse: Reuse for volunteer effort logs.

title: Handle recruitment logistics questions
workflow: Applicant's question -> retrieve a live job's process, location and dates -> explain the next application step or arrange staff contact.
implementationBoundary: No inferred protected characteristics, automated hiring decision or invented vacancy; only collect necessary applicant data.
saharaReuse: Reuse for volunteer recruitment logistics.

title: Capture a workplace incident report
workflow: Spoken description and optional document evidence -> extract when, where, what happened and immediate actions -> create an editable incident draft.
implementationBoundary: Do not determine fault or replace emergency procedures; preserve the employee's original account.
saharaReuse: Reuse for administrative incident reporting with access controls.

title: Dub onboarding training once for several teams
workflow: Approved induction video -> transcribe, translate and synthesize a reviewed dub -> export a regional-language training version.
implementationBoundary: Obtain speaker and content rights; verify safety instructions and timings before staff use.
saharaReuse: Reuse for consented volunteer and caregiver orientation content.

title: Create a daily operations briefing
workflow: Authorised calendar, task and email updates -> summarise today's deadlines and unresolved work -> produce a linked morning brief.
implementationBoundary: Connector permissions and scheduling need configuration; a generated briefing must not imply a task was completed.
saharaReuse: Reuse for coordinator workload planning without unnecessary health data.

title: Sort a shared inbox into actionable queues
workflow: Permitted shared-inbox messages -> classify requests and draft replies from known facts -> create a review queue for the correct owner.
implementationBoundary: Email access and sending are separate permissions; do not send generated replies automatically by default.
saharaReuse: Reuse for app-support triage.

title: Collect roster availability conversationally
workflow: Employees state availability and constraints -> extract explicit time windows -> present a conflict-checked availability grid to the planner.
implementationBoundary: A separate scheduler enforces labour rules and coverage; ask about contradictions instead of guessing.
saharaReuse: Reuse for volunteer visit availability.

title: Practice spoken English with contextual feedback
workflow: Learner speaks a role-play answer -> transcribe or translate the question and generate feedback -> continue practice in a selected language.
implementationBoundary: Transcription errors are not learner mistakes; let learners inspect and correct what was heard.
saharaReuse: Reuse communication practice for staff using fictional scenarios.

title: Build assisted reading exercises
workflow: Teacher-selected short passage -> synthesize a clear reading model and compare learner transcript with expected text -> highlight words to practice.
implementationBoundary: Do not claim a validated speech, learning or disability assessment; teachers review the exercise.
saharaReuse: Reuse the listen-and-repeat interface for non-clinical app onboarding.

title: Caption a live class
workflow: Consented lecture audio -> stream transcription and optional translation -> display captions with a correctable saved transcript.
implementationBoundary: Latency and errors need classroom testing; this does not guarantee sign-language access or legally sufficient accommodation.
saharaReuse: Reuse for consented teaching sessions.

title: Create an accessible textbook audiobook
workflow: Licensed textbook text -> divide at meaningful sections and synthesize narration -> export navigable chapter audio with matching text.
implementationBoundary: Obtain publishing rights and review formulas, abbreviations and pronunciation; audio is not automatically an accessible ebook.
saharaReuse: Reuse for approved educational leaflets as offline audio.

title: Draft teacher-reviewed practice worksheets
workflow: Curriculum excerpt and learning objective -> generate exercises and an answer key -> teacher edits and releases a worksheet.
implementationBoundary: Check every answer and age suitability; the model cannot certify curriculum alignment.
saharaReuse: Reuse for volunteer-training exercises.

title: Run an oral knowledge quiz
workflow: Approved question bank and spoken answer -> transcribe and compare with a supplied rubric -> give feedback and record a tentative practice result.
implementationBoundary: Use for practice, not unsupervised high-stakes grading; a transcription correction must be possible.
saharaReuse: Reuse for checking staff comprehension of approved procedures.

title: Translate parent notices without losing key dates
workflow: Verified notice and event details -> translate with a glossary and date checks -> send an approved parent-language notice.
implementationBoundary: Human-check deadlines, fees and consent wording; school messaging infrastructure is a separate integration.
saharaReuse: Reuse for accurate appointment-preparation notices.

title: Explain programming concepts in familiar language
workflow: Code excerpt and conceptual question -> explain the relevant concept and propose a small runnable example -> learner tests it.
implementationBoundary: Generated code is untrusted until tested; do not upload secrets or claim correctness from explanation alone.
saharaReuse: Reuse for the Sahara team's internal learning.

title: Give revision feedback on a draft essay
workflow: Student's draft and rubric -> identify unclear structure and examples -> provide suggestions tied to existing passages.
implementationBoundary: Keep authorship visible; do not fabricate sources, substitute an entire assessed submission or guarantee a grade.
saharaReuse: Reuse for improving non-clinical communications.

title: Plan study around real commitments
workflow: Exam dates, topics, available time and progress -> reason over constraints -> produce an editable weekly study plan.
implementationBoundary: Calendar writes need confirmation; the plan must preserve user-entered limits rather than invent free time.
saharaReuse: Reuse the constraint-aware planning pattern for training.

title: Explain a public scheme from current rules
workflow: Question and official scheme notice -> retrieve eligibility and application rules -> give a cited plain-language explanation.
implementationBoundary: Use current official sources; no promise of eligibility, payment or government affiliation.
saharaReuse: Reuse for verified assistance-scheme navigation.

title: Prepare an application evidence checklist
workflow: User's stated situation and official form requirements -> identify required versus missing documents -> produce a personalised checklist.
implementationBoundary: Do not submit forms, invent facts or collect full IDs unnecessarily; final eligibility remains with the authority.
saharaReuse: Reuse for support-scheme paperwork assistance.

title: File a civic grievance by voice
workflow: Spoken complaint and user-confirmed location -> extract a concise description and route category -> show a grievance draft and eventual real receipt.
implementationBoundary: The municipality supplies the submission API and receipt; a generated reference number is forbidden.
saharaReuse: Reuse for a real administrative feedback flow.

title: Make public budget tables explorable
workflow: Official scanned budget pages -> extract tables and normalise labels -> provide searchable rows with links back to pages.
implementationBoundary: Validate totals and units using code; OCR does not establish corruption or expenditure outcomes.
saharaReuse: Reuse for public-sector funding analysis.

title: Answer utility-outage questions from live notices
workflow: Authenticated locality and spoken question -> retrieve the utility's actual outage notice -> explain scope and published restoration estimate.
implementationBoundary: The provider supplies status; do not invent restoration times or conceal missing updates.
saharaReuse: Reuse the verified-status pattern for service availability.

title: Validate crop-survey entries with farmers
workflow: Existing crop record and consented farmer call -> read back crop and acreage fields and capture corrections -> flag records needing field verification.
implementationBoundary: Corrections are claims for verification, not proof of acreage; field systems and consent remain necessary.
saharaReuse: Reuse read-back confirmation of administrative records.

title: Capture a spoken farm operations diary
workflow: Spoken sowing, labour and input-use notes -> extract dated activities and units -> save a farmer-reviewed operations timeline.
implementationBoundary: Do not infer applications, quantities or crop health that were not stated; the farmer can revise records.
saharaReuse: Reuse quick diary entry interaction.

title: Read trusted market bulletins aloud
workflow: Current official price bulletin -> translate and synthesize a concise crop/location-specific bulletin -> deliver audio with source date and market.
implementationBoundary: Market prices need a separate current feed; no price prediction, trade recommendation or assured sale price.
saharaReuse: Reuse source-dated public-information audio.

title: Prepare an agronomist consultation request
workflow: Spoken crop problem and available context -> extract explicit observations, duration and requested help -> create a structured case for a qualified agronomist.
implementationBoundary: Do not diagnose plant disease or recommend chemical dosage from the model; expert advice is a separate human service.
saharaReuse: Reuse the request-preparation pattern while respecting clinical boundaries.

title: Explain an approved preparedness plan
workflow: Local authority's preparedness guide and resident question -> retrieve the relevant procedure -> explain it in local-language text or audio.
implementationBoundary: Use official current instructions; not live hazard detection, emergency dispatch or an all-clear service.
saharaReuse: Reuse pre-approved continuity and contingency information.

title: Sort expense receipts for bookkeeping
workflow: Authorised receipt scans -> extract merchant, date and amount -> suggest ledger categories for a reviewed expense import.
implementationBoundary: An accountant checks tax treatment and duplicates; deterministic code handles arithmetic and currency.
saharaReuse: Reuse for operational expense administration.

title: Prepare an invoice accounts-payable entry
workflow: Supplier invoice -> extract vendor, due date, line items and payment terms -> create a source-linked payable draft.
implementationBoundary: OCR is not vendor authentication; payment details need independent verification and no automatic transfer.
saharaReuse: Reuse for organisation administration.

title: Explain an insurance policy in plain language
workflow: Actual policy wording and user question -> locate relevant exclusions and conditions -> produce a cited explanation and questions for the insurer.
implementationBoundary: Do not determine coverage, offer regulated advice or promise claims payment; retain the original policy as authoritative.
saharaReuse: Reuse administrative insurance navigation with qualified support.

title: Remind customers of a verified due date
workflow: Actual account due amount and date -> generate a permitted reminder and capture questions -> record acknowledgement or human callback request.
implementationBoundary: Comply with calling, collections and privacy rules; no coercion, hidden fees or automatic debit.
saharaReuse: Do not reuse for charging patients for essential care.

title: Explain a genuine fraud alert safely
workflow: Bank-generated alert event and approved safety script -> translate and speak the alert -> direct the customer to the bank's verified channel.
implementationBoundary: Never ask for OTPs, PINs or passwords; fraud detection and trusted delivery originate from the bank, not the model.
saharaReuse: Reuse anti-scam education using only approved public scripts.

title: Read a statement accessibly
workflow: User-authorised statement and selected date range -> extract transactions and synthesize an itemised reading -> let the holder navigate entries.
implementationBoundary: Treat financial data as confidential; verify amounts and never speak private balances on an unverified shared channel.
saharaReuse: Reuse private read-aloud controls after appropriate data safeguards.

title: Explain an unfamiliar fee line
workflow: Exact fee description, bill and tariff document -> retrieve matching tariff wording -> explain the charge or draft a clarification request.
implementationBoundary: The model cannot establish whether a fee is lawful; staff review and source evidence are needed for disputes.
saharaReuse: Reuse transparent explanation of any institutional service charges.

title: Index paperwork for a tax professional
workflow: Permitted receipts, certificates and statements -> extract document types, periods and missing references -> create a source-linked preparation index.
implementationBoundary: Not tax calculation, filing or legal advice; retain original records and restrict access.
saharaReuse: Reuse non-patient organisational compliance preparation.

title: Draft a grant utilisation narrative from evidence
workflow: Verified expenditure rows and activity logs -> draft narrative sections tied to each evidence item -> prepare a reviewer-ready grant report.
implementationBoundary: Calculate figures separately; do not invent beneficiary counts, impact or approvals.
saharaReuse: Reuse for a truthful Sahara CSR or grant report.

title: Translate a remittance receipt for its recipient
workflow: Authorised transfer receipt -> extract reference, currency, fee and recipient information -> produce a reviewed translated explanation.
implementationBoundary: No currency conversion from model memory, payment initiation or proof of settlement beyond the source receipt.
saharaReuse: Reuse source-faithful administrative document explanation.

title: Preserve a scanned cultural archive
workflow: Rights-cleared scanned books -> OCR with reading order and headings -> create proofread searchable text linked to the scan.
implementationBoundary: Special typography requires evaluation; digitisation is not proof that every character is accurate or copyright has expired.
saharaReuse: Reuse the source-preservation and proofreading workbench pattern.

title: Digitise a handwritten attendance register
workflow: Permitted register pages -> extract names, dates and recorded attendance -> show a row-by-row correction screen before import.
implementationBoundary: Do not infer attendance from blank cells or accept OCR names without review; retain access-controlled originals.
saharaReuse: Reuse for volunteer registers, not fabricated visit proof.

title: Recover tables from scanned reports
workflow: Scanned non-medical report tables -> extract cell structure and units -> export CSV with original page references.
implementationBoundary: Merged cells, totals and decimal points need verification; exporting a table does not validate its source statistics.
saharaReuse: Reuse for administrative research and published statistics.

title: Compare contract versions by clause
workflow: Two authorised text versions -> align clauses and explain additions or deletions -> produce a source-linked change list.
implementationBoundary: Qualified counsel reviews legal meaning; model-generated comparison is not legal advice or signature authority.
saharaReuse: Reuse for vendor-contract preparation with review.

title: Translate a formatted operations manual
workflow: Rights-cleared PDF or Office manual -> document translation with glossary review -> export translated files in the original format.
implementationBoundary: Confirm formatting and safety-critical terminology; job success alone is not an approved usable manual.
saharaReuse: Reuse for reviewed non-clinical training manuals.

title: Prefill a credential profile from certificates
workflow: User-provided course certificates -> extract issuer, course, dates and named person -> prepare a profile for confirmation.
implementationBoundary: Extraction is not certificate authenticity or professional licence verification; check with issuers separately.
saharaReuse: Reuse for staff training records, not automatic clinician credentialing.

title: Find blank or contradictory form entries
workflow: Completed form and explicit validation rules -> extract fields and identify omissions or conflicting dates -> provide an actionable correction list.
implementationBoundary: Do not invent missing fields or override user responses; deterministic validation handles dates and formats.
saharaReuse: Reuse for fewer failed administrative form submissions.

title: Queue cross-document discrepancies
workflow: Authorised documents from the same claimed record -> compare extracted names and dates -> flag potential mismatches with source snippets.
implementationBoundary: This is not identity verification or a fraud verdict; humans resolve spelling variations and data rights.
saharaReuse: Reuse for non-clinical paperwork consistency review.

title: Build a bilingual source-linked knowledge search
workflow: Approved document corpus -> OCR where needed, index externally and retrieve passages -> answer questions with exact sources and language choice.
implementationBoundary: Search storage, retrieval and access control are ours to implement; answer abstention and source citations must be tested.
saharaReuse: Reuse for an approved care-education library, with clinical review.

title: Draft a formal letter from verified facts
workflow: User-confirmed facts and a selected correspondence template -> generate a concise letter -> user reviews, exports and chooses whether to send.
implementationBoundary: No fabricated claims, signatures, legal status or submission receipt; sending is a separate authorised action.
saharaReuse: Reuse for administrative requests and support correspondence.

title: Generate a narrated podcast from an approved script
workflow: Rights-cleared script with speaker labels -> synthesize distinct preset voices -> assemble a reviewed episode with chapter markers.
implementationBoundary: Use appropriate output rights and disclose synthetic voices; editing and audio assembly are separate work.
saharaReuse: Reuse for short approved educational audio episodes.

title: Dub an existing explainer video
workflow: Consented original recording -> translate the transcript and synthesize speaker-preserving audio -> export reviewed video, audio and subtitles.
implementationBoundary: Dubbing availability and voice consent must be checked; it does not automatically verify factual claims.
saharaReuse: Reuse for approved regional-language caregiver explainers.

title: Narrate author-written audio descriptions
workflow: Human-written scene descriptions and timings -> synthesize narration -> mix into an accessibility track.
implementationBoundary: The human supplies the visual description; do not imply Sarvam TTS can inspect a video or guarantee accessibility compliance.
saharaReuse: Reuse for accessible walkthroughs of the real app.

title: Prepare editable subtitle tracks from recordings
workflow: Consented recorded interview -> transcribe with timestamps and segment externally -> provide an editable subtitle timeline.
implementationBoundary: Timestamps are chunk-level, not guaranteed word-level; a subtitle editor checks timing and speaker changes.
saharaReuse: Reuse for recorded education content with human review.

title: Create a source-dated spoken news brief
workflow: Licensed current articles -> draft a short source-linked summary and synthesize it -> publish an editor-approved audio bulletin.
implementationBoundary: News retrieval, licensing and fact checking remain editorial work; do not present model memory as current news.
saharaReuse: Reuse the brief format for verified service announcements.

title: Adapt campaign copy across languages
workflow: Approved campaign facts and brand constraints -> generate culturally appropriate variants -> review and publish selected copy.
implementationBoundary: No invented endorsements, testimonials, medical benefits or misleading scarcity; review meaning in each target language.
saharaReuse: Reuse for truthful awareness campaigns.

title: Produce dialogue assets for a game
workflow: Original character lines -> synthesize selected authorised voices -> export and integrate reviewed audio assets.
implementationBoundary: Check commercial output rights and prohibited impersonation; runtime game logic is not supplied by TTS.
saharaReuse: Reuse only for fictional training role-plays, if needed.

title: Preserve an oral-history interview
workflow: Consented interview audio -> transcribe verbatim, label speakers and add translations -> provide a searchable archive with original audio.
implementationBoundary: Consent must cover publication and reuse; retain uncertain passages rather than invent memories.
saharaReuse: Reuse the consent and provenance approach for non-clinical storytelling.

title: Build a reviewed pronunciation asset library
workflow: Verified names, pronunciations and reusable phrases -> generate and human-check audio variants -> publish approved reusable clips.
implementationBoundary: Native-speaker checking remains necessary; a generated pronunciation is not authoritative because the model is Indian-language focused.
saharaReuse: Reuse for centre names and standard app prompts.

title: Check translated copy against a terminology glossary
workflow: Original text, candidate translation and approved glossary -> compare meaning and defined terms -> highlight passages for human correction.
implementationBoundary: Model agreement is not independent verification; qualified editors approve consequential wording.
saharaReuse: Reuse for bilingual palliative-care terminology under clinical review.

title: Capture a daily task list by voice
workflow: Spoken tasks and constraints -> extract separate tasks and ask about unclear wording -> save an editable checklist.
implementationBoundary: The app supplies persistence and undo; do not assign invented deadlines or contacts.
saharaReuse: Reuse for caregiver non-clinical chores.

title: Set a reminder through a short conversation
workflow: Spoken reminder request -> resolve the user's explicit local date and time and read it back -> schedule a confirmed device reminder.
implementationBoundary: Scheduling, time-zone handling and notification delivery need native code; model output alone is not an active reminder.
saharaReuse: Reuse for existing prescribed schedules without changing doses.

title: Fill an existing form through dictation
workflow: Chosen visible field and spoken answer -> transcribe into that field -> preserve an editable value and offer the next required field.
implementationBoundary: Respect field identity and accessibility focus; no automatic consequential submission or invention of user data.
saharaReuse: Reuse to reduce typing in Sahara forms.

title: Read a printed notice aloud
user: Person who cannot comfortably read the notice
workflow: User-provided notice scan -> OCR and synthesize the selected passage -> provide audio with zoomable original text.
implementationBoundary: Ask about unclear dates and amounts; no guaranteed scene understanding or replacement for official advice.
saharaReuse: Reuse for approved written instructions after verification.

title: Compose a message from a voice note
user: User writing to a known contact
workflow: Spoken intended message and chosen tone -> transcribe and lightly organise it -> return an editable text draft.
implementationBoundary: No sending without user confirmation and no invented commitments or intimate familiarity.
saharaReuse: Reuse to prepare a message to an existing care coordinator.

title: Prepare a travel booking shortlist
workflow: Spoken dates, budget and accessibility needs -> query real authorised travel inventory -> compare a few options for review.
implementationBoundary: A separate provider supplies availability and prices; booking and payment require explicit confirmation.
saharaReuse: Reuse the comparison interface for verified transport options.

title: Translate a transport announcement
user: Traveller who cannot understand the announcement
workflow: Consented captured announcement -> transcribe and translate the text -> show original and translated wording.
implementationBoundary: Noisy public-address audio needs testing; display uncertainty and do not promise platform changes or live travel status beyond the recording.
saharaReuse: Reuse a source-visible translation interface.

title: Control permitted home devices by voice
workflow: Spoken device command -> extract an allow-listed intent and target -> ask confirmation where needed and invoke the authorised device API.
implementationBoundary: Device integration, authentication and safety interlocks are separate; never unlock doors or operate hazardous equipment from an uncertain transcript.
saharaReuse: Reuse only low-risk accessibility controls.

title: Screen unknown calls for a personal inbox
workflow: Incoming caller conversation -> capture identity claim and stated purpose -> present a call summary and user-controlled callback option.
implementationBoundary: Telephony access, recording consent and call-routing support are prerequisites; claimed caller identity is not verified identity.
saharaReuse: Reuse the human callback queue pattern; do not impersonate a clinician.

title: Search a private spoken journal
workflow: Consented voice entries -> transcribe and index externally -> retrieve matching personal entries with dates and original snippets.
implementationBoundary: Private storage, deletion and access controls are ours; no emotional diagnosis or claim of perfect memory.
saharaReuse: Reuse a private search pattern only after appropriate health-data terms and consent.

title: Draft a scoped code change from a requirement
workflow: Repository excerpt, tests and a bounded requirement -> propose a patch with an explanation -> developer reviews and runs it in the existing project.
implementationBoundary: Generated code needs testing and security review; never expose repository secrets or claim a deployed change from a code draft.
saharaReuse: Reuse for Sahara maintenance with the normal review and build process.

title: Design behaviour-focused test cases
workflow: Feature contract and known failure modes -> generate edge-case scenarios and expected outcomes -> produce a reviewed test plan or test skeletons.
implementationBoundary: Tests must exercise real behaviour; generated passing-looking output is not evidence that any test ran.
saharaReuse: Reuse for less-click flows and data-preservation regressions.

title: Triage sanitised error logs
workflow: Redacted logs plus deployment facts -> group failures and propose likely causes -> return evidence-linked investigation steps.
implementationBoundary: Remove secrets and personal data; hypotheses remain hypotheses until reproduced and fixed.
saharaReuse: Reuse for private operational debugging without patient records.

title: Ask questions of an allow-listed analytics database
workflow: Natural-language question and approved schema -> draft a read-only query -> validate and execute through a constrained backend, then explain the actual result.
sarvamCapability: Sarvam-105B tool calling and structured output
implementationBoundary: Enforce row permissions and read-only access in code, not the prompt; never execute unrestricted model SQL.
saharaReuse: Reuse for authorised aggregate product analytics after privacy review.

title: Pre-label a language dataset for human annotation
workflow: Rights-cleared text and a fixed label guide -> suggest categories with supporting spans -> send uncertain cases to annotators.
implementationBoundary: Generated labels are provisional; use independent human checks and avoid fabricated confidence statistics.
saharaReuse: Reuse for de-identified support categories, not autonomous clinical labels.

title: Build a speech-recognition evaluation workbench
workflow: Consented test audio and human reference transcripts -> run selected Saaras configurations and calculate error rates externally -> compare real measured errors by scenario.
implementationBoundary: The app must implement scoring and sample governance; do not substitute vendor benchmarks for our measured accents, noise and terminology.
saharaReuse: Reuse before any clinical dictation pilot, using synthetic or explicitly permitted data.

title: Review software localisation in context
workflow: UI string keys, screenshots described by the team and glossary -> translate strings and flag length or terminology risks -> produce a reviewable localisation file.
implementationBoundary: Developers still check rendered layouts, placeholders and plural rules; translation alone does not verify UI fit.
saharaReuse: Reuse directly for Sahara's Hindi, Kannada and other approved language screens.

title: Generate synthetic conversation fixtures
workflow: Explicit fictional personas and coverage goals -> generate varied test dialogues and optional synthetic audio -> feed a labelled test suite.
implementationBoundary: Keep fixtures visibly synthetic in test tooling; no real-person voice cloning or claims that simulated calls prove field performance.
saharaReuse: Reuse for goals-of-care interaction tests without real patient conversations.

title: Route a natural-language request to safe app tools
workflow: User request and an allow-list of app actions -> select a typed tool call with validated arguments -> show the resulting real action or a confirmation.
implementationBoundary: Permissions, idempotency and confirmation are backend responsibilities; model tool selection does not confer authorisation.
saharaReuse: Reuse for fewer taps when opening an existing record or drafting a task.

title: Map requirements to missing verification evidence
workflow: Adopted requirements, actual implementation notes and real test results -> map each requirement to evidence and gaps -> generate a reviewer checklist.
implementationBoundary: Do not invent test runs, approvals or coverage; retain links to the actual evidence and mark absent proof.
saharaReuse: Reuse for Sahara release readiness without confusing a build with Play approval.

title: Speak to navigate Sahara
workflow: Spoken screen request -> recognize an allowed intent -> open matching screen and read its label
requiredHumanReview: User confirms writes and sharing.
implementationBoundary: Navigation only; no urgent-care decision inferred from intent.

title: Hear the signed care plan
workflow: Clinician-approved plan -> synthesize unchanged text -> replay the latest signed instructions
requiredHumanReview: Clinician approves source; bilingual reviewer checks clinical numbers and pronunciation.
implementationBoundary: No invented instruction or dose change; retain readable source and version.

title: Consent-based consultation captions
user: Patient with hearing difficulty and clinician
workflow: Consented encounter audio -> transcribe with uncertain spans -> visible editable captions
requiredHumanReview: Clinician and patient resolve important errors during the encounter.
implementationBoundary: A communication aid, not a certified interpreter or final clinical record.

title: Interpreter-supported language relay
workflow: Utterance -> transcribe and translate side by side -> interpreter verifies before action
requiredHumanReview: Qualified interpreter or bilingual clinician verifies consequential meaning.
implementationBoundary: Never replace human verification for consent, prognosis or emergency communication.

title: Preserve names and preferred scripts
workflow: Spoken name and preferred script -> propose spelling -> patient-confirmed profile name
requiredHumanReview: Patient or registrar verifies spelling and identity.
implementationBoundary: No automatic patient matching or merging by similar names.

title: Plain-language discharge draft
workflow: Signed discharge instructions -> draft shorter explanation retaining facts -> approved patient handout
requiredHumanReview: Discharge clinician checks medicines, warnings, times and omissions.
implementationBoundary: Do not compress away warnings; link the signed original.

title: Record teach-back for the nurse
workflow: Patient explains agreed plan aloud -> exact transcript beside plan -> nurse checks understanding
requiredHumanReview: Nurse judges understanding and reteaches where needed.
implementationBoundary: No automated pass/fail score or authorization for a clinical task.

title: Turn a voice concern into a message
workflow: Spoken care-team question -> concise faithful message draft -> user previews and sends
requiredHumanReview: Sender confirms wording and recipient; clinician answers.
implementationBoundary: Do not answer the clinical question while drafting it.

title: Listen to a verified document
user: Patient with low vision or fatigue
workflow: Selected document and verified text -> read section by section -> accessible playback with page reference
requiredHumanReview: Clinical fields are checked against the image before playback.
implementationBoundary: Uncertain medicine text must stop rather than be guessed aloud.

title: Explain sharing choices accessibly
workflow: Actual sharing screen -> approved plain-language explanation/audio -> patient selects record access
requiredHumanReview: Privacy lead approves explanations; patient chooses and may revise.
implementationBoundary: AI does not consent for the person or establish caregiver legal authority.

title: Dictate a clinician visit note
workflow: Clinician dictation -> exact transcript and template placement -> unsigned editable note
requiredHumanReview: Clinician verifies and signs.
implementationBoundary: No inferred diagnosis, normal findings or treatment plan.

title: Capture a home nurse's observations
workflow: After-visit dictation -> organize stated observations and completed tasks -> reviewed visit entry
requiredHumanReview: Nurse checks facts and signs.
implementationBoundary: Do not infer that an omitted examination was normal or a planned task happened.

title: Make an MDT action record
workflow: Consented meeting audio -> attributed transcript and explicit decisions -> owners, deadlines and meeting draft
requiredHumanReview: Meeting chair checks decisions, speakers and assignments.
implementationBoundary: Speaker labels need confirmation; generate no new clinical consensus.

title: Prepare a transition handover
workflow: Signed notes plus approved template -> source-linked relevant facts -> handover draft
requiredHumanReview: Responsible clinician verifies and signs before transfer.
implementationBoundary: No automatic chart export or disclosure without record-level authorization.

title: Document a nurse callback
workflow: Consented callback recording -> concerns, advice actually given and next steps -> approved call note
requiredHumanReview: Nurse checks against audio before saving.
implementationBoundary: Never fill missing advice or invent a completed referral.

title: Assemble a referral packet
workflow: Approved referral reason and selected documents -> organize dated references -> approved referral bundle
requiredHumanReview: Referrer verifies identity, reason and minimum necessary contents.
implementationBoundary: No automatic eligibility decision or document sharing.

title: Build a patient-stated history timeline
workflow: Confirmed patient statements and dated records -> chronological organization -> provenance-linked timeline
requiredHumanReview: Clinician resolves conflicting accounts and dates.
implementationBoundary: Separate reported and observed findings; infer no disease progression.

title: Find the right historical record
workflow: Question about a prior signed record -> search access-controlled OCR/metadata -> page and matching extract
requiredHumanReview: User opens original before using the clinical fact.
implementationBoundary: No unsupported answer or cross-patient record merge.

title: Flag documentation gaps for completion
workflow: Unsigned draft plus local field schema -> locate blanks or unsupported fields -> completion checklist
requiredHumanReview: Author decides missing, not applicable or intentionally absent.
implementationBoundary: Flag absence only; never fabricate values or infer consent.

title: Link a correction to original words
workflow: Correction and audio timestamp -> align edited field to source -> auditable corrected note
requiredHumanReview: Clinician approves correction and amendment history.
implementationBoundary: No silent rewriting of the clinical record.

title: Prepare what matters before a visit
workflow: Optional spoken reflections -> organize patient's own words -> private clinician-discussion agenda
requiredHumanReview: Patient approves reflection; clinician interprets in visit.
implementationBoundary: No prognosis, medical decision or advance directive from reflections.

title: Draft the clinician-led GOCD record
workflow: Consented goals-of-care discussion -> transcript and evidence-linked sections -> unsigned goals-of-care draft
requiredHumanReview: Clinician reviews with patient and signs.
implementationBoundary: Do not infer preferences, code status or decisions from silence or vague remarks.

title: Record information preferences
workflow: Patient states what they want to know and who may hear -> structured draft -> confirmed communication card
requiredHumanReview: Patient and clinician confirm current preference.
implementationBoundary: Does not establish capacity or substitute decision-maker authority.

title: Keep hopes and worries in the patient's words
workflow: Patient-selected reflection -> faithful transcript and optional categories -> approved quotes beside notes
requiredHumanReview: Patient approves quotes to be shared.
implementationBoundary: No sentiment score, psychiatric label or survival prediction.

title: Prepare participation for a family meeting
workflow: Named people, language needs and disclosure scope -> meeting checklist -> coordinator arranges participation
requiredHumanReview: Patient confirms participation/disclosure; coordinator verifies contacts.
implementationBoundary: Attendance gives no automatic decision authority or whole-record access.

title: Show changes in confirmed care goals
workflow: Dated signed goal records -> highlight explicit text differences -> review of current wishes
requiredHumanReview: Clinician and patient confirm what still applies.
implementationBoundary: No automatic replacement of goals or interpretation of contradictions.

title: Create a patient-approved GOCD recap
workflow: Signed note -> plain-language translated draft -> reviewed take-home summary
requiredHumanReview: Clinician and bilingual reviewer verify; patient confirms meaning.
implementationBoundary: No binding directive or medical order; link signed original.

title: Build an agenda for a difficult family discussion
workflow: Approved concerns and open questions -> organize neutral topics -> human-led meeting agenda
requiredHumanReview: Social worker checks neutrality and patient priorities.
implementationBoundary: No autonomous mediation or pressure toward a care option.

title: List unresolved care questions without deciding them
workflow: Meeting transcript -> identify explicit unanswered/disputed points -> next-discussion question list
requiredHumanReview: Facilitator checks attribution and omissions.
implementationBoundary: No AI finding of best-interest treatment, capacity or who is right.

title: Track agreed GOCD follow-up actions
workflow: Signed discussion's explicit actions -> convert approved actions into assigned tasks -> reminders and completion record
requiredHumanReview: Clinician approves clinical tasks; person confirms completion.
implementationBoundary: No new decision or completed-care claim from a reminder or checkbox.

title: Speak a daily symptom diary
workflow: Today's experience in patient's words -> transcribe report fields -> confirm and save for team review
requiredHumanReview: Patient confirms entry; clinician interprets clinical meaning.
implementationBoundary: No diagnosis, urgency score or dosing advice; immediate help access stays separate.

title: Capture a clinician-selected symptom questionnaire
workflow: Approved instrument delivered aloud -> capture answers verbatim -> nurse receives responses
requiredHumanReview: Clinician selects instrument and interprets; patient confirms recognized answers.
implementationBoundary: Use licensed locally validated wording; scoring only deterministic and separately approved.

title: Summarize changes the patient reported
workflow: Confirmed dated diary entries -> compare explicit values/quotes -> source-linked change summary
requiredHumanReview: Nurse checks sources and decides action.
implementationBoundary: No progression inference, predicted deterioration or autonomous clinical prioritization.

title: Turn an unstructured worry into a callback request
workflow: Spoken concern and contact preference -> capture request -> receipt in staffed team's queue
requiredHumanReview: Nurse reads concern and decides urgency using local protocol.
implementationBoundary: Do not promise continuous monitoring; emergency route cannot depend on model interpretation.

title: Record sleep and meaningful activity
workflow: Patient describes rest and activities -> organize stated account -> functional diary
requiredHumanReview: Patient confirms; clinician reviews when clinically used.
implementationBoundary: No insomnia diagnosis, performance-status estimate or exercise recommendation.

title: Log observations about food and fluids
workflow: Observed intake and uncertainty -> preserve exact quantities -> confirmed observation log
requiredHumanReview: Caregiver confirms; nurse assesses need for action.
implementationBoundary: No nutritional prescription, fluid target or judgement that intake is safe.

title: Prepare a pain conversation
workflow: Words about discomfort and worries -> questions plus attributed timeline -> appointment discussion aid
requiredHumanReview: Patient confirms; clinician assesses pain and treatment.
implementationBoundary: No diagnosis, opioid recommendation or dose adjustment.

title: Retrieve an approved home-care instruction
workflow: Question plus current signed nursing plan -> retrieve approved passage -> source and exact read-aloud
requiredHumanReview: Nurse approves library and patient-specific applicability.
implementationBoundary: If no approved match, offer staff contact instead of generating procedural steps.

title: Read back nurse-dictated measurements
workflow: Nurse dictates an already measured value, unit and time -> transcribe into separate fields -> read back for correction before saving
requiredHumanReview: Nurse verifies the exact value, unit, time and patient identity against the measurement before saving.
implementationBoundary: Do not infer a missing unit, calculate a new measurement, interpret a reading or recommend a response. Keep the original dictation available; this does not connect a medical device.

title: Replay the clinician's emergency contact plan
workflow: Approved contact plan -> exact accessible display/audio -> one-tap verified service call
requiredHumanReview: Care team verifies contacts and plan version.
implementationBoundary: No AI triage, reassurance or delay; verified call access works without generation.

title: Transcribe a prescription into a review screen
workflow: Prescription image -> extract written fields with source links -> unconfirmed medicine draft
requiredHumanReview: Pharmacist or prescriber verifies every field against original.
implementationBoundary: No guessed handwriting, new prescription or reminder before professional approval.

title: Prepare medication reconciliation discrepancies
workflow: Two source lists -> highlight literal differences and provenance -> reconciliation worksheet
requiredHumanReview: Pharmacist or clinician decides current list.
implementationBoundary: Never automatically start, stop, merge or deduplicate medicines by fuzzy matching.

title: Record a patient's medicine-taking statement
workflow: Spoken account of what was taken and when -> read back uncertainties -> confirmed self-report log
requiredHumanReview: Reporter confirms; pharmacist reviews discrepancies.
implementationBoundary: No catch-up-dose advice, timing change or adherence inference from app opens.

title: Draft a refill request
workflow: Verified medicine plus request -> unchanged enquiry draft -> patient approves pharmacy message
requiredHumanReview: Pharmacist checks validity and approves dispensing.
implementationBoundary: No automatic controlled-drug order, renewal or availability promise.

title: Collect questions for a pharmacist
workflow: Spoken uncertainty and approved medicine list -> preserve exact question -> pharmacist message draft
requiredHumanReview: Patient confirms; pharmacist answers.
implementationBoundary: No generated interaction, substitution, side-effect or dosing advice.

title: Hear the approved medication schedule
workflow: Professionally verified schedule -> exact spoken labels -> replayable schedule
requiredHumanReview: Pharmacist checks pronunciation, numbers and source version.
implementationBoundary: No schedule from unverified OCR; keep units and warnings.

title: Translate test preparation instructions
workflow: Lab-approved preparation sheet -> translated draft -> reviewed pre-test instructions
requiredHumanReview: Lab team and qualified bilingual reviewer check clinical meaning.
implementationBoundary: Do not invent fasting times, medicine holds or test eligibility.

title: Find a value on an existing lab report
workflow: Selected report image -> OCR with page/bounding box -> copyable source-linked value
requiredHumanReview: Clinician checks original and units.
implementationBoundary: No abnormality interpretation, diagnosis or mismatched-method trend comparison.

title: Record a suspected medicine problem accurately
workflow: Patient's experience -> exact transcript, uncertain names left uncertain -> callback/report record
requiredHumanReview: Pharmacist or clinician assesses causality and urgency.
implementationBoundary: No adverse-reaction diagnosis or advice to stop therapy; urgent contact independent of AI.

title: Make a prescription clarification checklist
workflow: Extracted fields and ambiguous spans -> list prescriber questions -> clarification worksheet
requiredHumanReview: Pharmacist checks ambiguities and contacts prescriber.
implementationBoundary: Never complete missing strength, route, frequency or duration.

category: Caregiver support, family coordination and dignity
title: Make a caregiver shift handover
workflow: Approved practical tasks and notes -> concise handover by owner -> reviewed shift summary
requiredHumanReview: Outgoing caregiver approves; nurse handles clinical uncertainty.
implementationBoundary: No clinical instructions beyond separately approved plan or unauthorized sharing.

category: Caregiver support, family coordination and dignity
title: Split practical tasks among willing helpers
workflow: Offered help and availability -> draft meals/travel/companionship rota -> helpers accept tasks
requiredHumanReview: Helpers accept assignments; patient approves participation.
implementationBoundary: No clinical staffing decisions or detailed diagnosis shared with helpers.

category: Caregiver support, family coordination and dignity
title: Request respite or practical relief
workflow: Needed support and time constraints -> structured request -> verified respite-service enquiry
requiredHumanReview: Caregiver approves request; coordinator checks suitability.
implementationBoundary: No availability promise or assessment that an unattended patient is safe.

category: Caregiver support, family coordination and dignity
title: Keep a caregiver needs journal
workflow: Optional reflection on workload -> summarize selected needs -> private journal or chosen support request
requiredHumanReview: Caregiver controls sharing; counselor reviews clinical concerns.
implementationBoundary: No mental-health diagnosis, risk inference or emotional manipulation.

category: Caregiver support, family coordination and dignity
title: Revisit nurse-taught caregiving material
workflow: Question about prior training -> retrieve approved teaching segment -> accessible replay and question button
requiredHumanReview: Clinical educator approves content; nurse checks skill with teach-back/show-me.
implementationBoundary: No generated coaching for injections, feeding tubes or wound procedures.

category: Caregiver support, family coordination and dignity
title: Arrange a counselor conversation
workflow: User requests emotional support -> capture language/availability preferences -> counselor appointment request
requiredHumanReview: User approves contact; counselor assesses needs.
implementationBoundary: No therapy replacement, diagnosis or automatic disclosure to relatives.

category: Caregiver support, family coordination and dignity
title: Draft a consented family update
workflow: Approved facts and selected recipients -> translated short update -> patient preview before sharing
requiredHumanReview: Patient and clinician verify clinical statements.
implementationBoundary: No diagnosis or prognosis disclosure outside approved scope.

category: Caregiver support, family coordination and dignity
title: Find bereavement support
workflow: Requested location and support preferences -> search vetted directory -> dated contact options
requiredHumanReview: Coordinator verifies directory; user chooses contact.
implementationBoundary: No grief diagnosis, unsolicited follow-up or labels of normal/abnormal grief.

category: Caregiver support, family coordination and dignity
title: Preserve personal stories and messages
workflow: Consented personal recording -> transcript and optional chapters -> patient-edited keepsake
requiredHumanReview: Patient approves edits, storage and recipients.
implementationBoundary: No voice cloning, invented memories or unapproved posthumous sharing.

category: Caregiver support, family coordination and dignity
title: Plan family travel for a care visit
workflow: Confirmed location, dates and accessibility -> organize verified travel/stay options -> practical checklist
requiredHumanReview: Family verifies details before purchase.
implementationBoundary: No booking/payment without specific authorization or implied medical transport capability.

category: Appointments, home visits and service navigation
title: Ask for a suitable palliative-care centre
workflow: Spoken location and service needs -> filter verified directory fields -> centre cards and MapLibre location
requiredHumanReview: Directory staff verifies facts; patient/clinician confirms clinical suitability.
implementationBoundary: No AI quality ranking, diagnosis-based eligibility or bed promise.

category: Appointments, home visits and service navigation
title: Hear a centre's real access instructions
workflow: Verified centre record -> read phone, hours and referral requirements -> accessible contact card
requiredHumanReview: Service owner confirms current access information.
implementationBoundary: Use verified dated metadata; never invent walk-in rules or hours.

category: Appointments, home visits and service navigation
title: Book an allowed follow-up slot by voice
workflow: Spoken preference and real availability -> permitted slot proposal -> confirmation and backend booking receipt
requiredHumanReview: Patient confirms; clinic system is final authority.
implementationBoundary: Server-side identity, permission and slot checks; generated text is not a booking.

category: Appointments, home visits and service navigation
title: Change or cancel a booked visit
workflow: Existing visit and change request -> check scheduling rules -> confirmation then audited update
requiredHumanReview: Authorized user confirms exact change.
implementationBoundary: No cancellation by predicted attendance or ambiguous speech; preserve booking on failure.

category: Appointments, home visits and service navigation
title: Understand a missed-visit barrier
workflow: Opt-in follow-up conversation -> record stated barrier and requested help -> staff action request
requiredHumanReview: Coordinator reviews; user confirms rebooking.
implementationBoundary: No blame, automatic discharge or noncompliance inference; honor opt-outs.

category: Appointments, home visits and service navigation
title: Arrange a home visit
workflow: Access needs, availability and existing referral -> scheduling checklist -> coordinator-confirmed visit
requiredHumanReview: Coordinator validates referral and staff capability.
implementationBoundary: No automatic urgency or staffing-safety decision; no visit claim before acceptance.

category: Appointments, home visits and service navigation
title: Request accessible transport help
workflow: Stated mobility needs and appointment -> capture requirements -> reviewed transport enquiry
requiredHumanReview: Transport provider and care team confirm safe suitability.
implementationBoundary: Do not decide ordinary transport is medically safe or replace an ambulance.

category: Appointments, home visits and service navigation
title: Request prescribed equipment support
workflow: Clinician-approved equipment requirement -> delivery/loan constraints -> verified service request
requiredHumanReview: Clinician confirms device; equipment team verifies specification/training.
implementationBoundary: No device selection, oxygen setting, substitute or payment commitment.

category: Appointments, home visits and service navigation
title: Prepare documents for a benefit enquiry
workflow: Current official checklist and selected document metadata -> missing-paperwork draft -> social-worker review list
requiredHumanReview: Social worker verifies scheme rules and details.
implementationBoundary: No eligibility, coverage or reimbursement guarantee; no automatic submission.

category: Appointments, home visits and service navigation
title: Close the loop on a referral
workflow: Real referral identifier and service status -> reconcile actual acknowledgements -> next-action status card
requiredHumanReview: Coordinator confirms receipt, appointment and outcome.
implementationBoundary: Sent message is not accepted referral or completed consultation.

title: Explain an oncology term from a curated glossary
workflow: Selected unfamiliar term -> retrieve approved definition and translation draft -> source-linked explanation
requiredHumanReview: Oncology educator and bilingual reviewer approve definitions.
implementationBoundary: Vocabulary only; no personalized stage, diagnosis or prognosis inference.

title: Prepare an oncology appointment question list
workflow: Priorities and uncertainties -> editable agenda -> questions for oncologist and palliative team
requiredHumanReview: Patient approves priorities; clinician answers.
implementationBoundary: Do not choose therapy or answer life-expectancy questions.

title: Preserve the clinician's stated treatment intent
workflow: Clinician explanation -> exact transcript -> doctor-reviewed intent note and recap
requiredHumanReview: Oncologist verifies and discusses meaning with patient.
implementationBoundary: Never infer cure, palliation or prognosis from regimen or stage.

title: Coordinate an approved treatment calendar
workflow: Actual visits and signed schedule -> organize dates unchanged -> confirmed calendar/travel reminders
requiredHumanReview: Oncology service verifies schedule and clinical changes.
implementationBoundary: No chemotherapy timing, delay or dose recommendation; source systems authoritative.

title: Localize approved radiotherapy preparation material
workflow: Centre-approved leaflet -> translated draft preserving details -> approved accessible handout
requiredHumanReview: Radiotherapy team and qualified language reviewer approve.
implementationBoundary: No site-specific restrictions generated from generic material.

title: Retrieve the team's approved aftercare contacts
workflow: Current oncology aftercare plan -> requested approved section/contact -> source-linked instructions
requiredHumanReview: Oncology team verifies plan and escalation route.
implementationBoundary: No toxicity grading, symptom triage or reassurance to delay; contact staff if source absent.

title: Prepare questions for a dietitian
workflow: Stated food difficulties/priorities -> faithful questions -> dietitian consultation agenda
requiredHumanReview: Patient confirms; dietitian assesses and advises.
implementationBoundary: No meal plan, supplement or fluid prescription.

title: Communicate rehabilitation priorities
workflow: Meaningful activity goals -> stated barriers -> therapist-reviewed goals agenda
requiredHumanReview: Therapist assesses capability and approves interventions.
implementationBoundary: No exercise prescription, fall-risk score or claim an activity is safe.

title: Search verified supportive-care study information
workflow: Selected topic/location -> filter approved trial-directory metadata -> study links and nurse questions
requiredHumanReview: Research clinician verifies study status and eligibility discussion.
implementationBoundary: No automatic eligibility, enrollment recommendation or invented recruitment status.

title: Prepare age-appropriate family communication material
workflow: Team-approved scenario/content -> draft language adaptation -> professionally reviewed family material
requiredHumanReview: Pediatric clinician, counselor and guardian review.
implementationBoundary: No autonomous child companion or prognosis conversation; age/consent safeguards required.

category: Provider operations, records and quality improvement
title: Capture nonclinical intake by voice
workflow: Contact, preferred language and visit purpose -> administrative prefill -> patient-confirmed registration draft
requiredHumanReview: Registrar verifies identity; patient confirms fields.
implementationBoundary: No diagnosis coding or automatic patient merge; minimize data collection.

category: Provider operations, records and quality improvement
title: Route an inbound service call
workflow: Appointment/record/billing request -> allowed administrative queue -> human handoff or confirmed task
requiredHumanReview: Staff owns resolution; caller confirms consequential actions.
implementationBoundary: Clinical questions go to qualified staff; no triage or unstaffed emergency promise.

category: Provider operations, records and quality improvement
title: Keep the centre directory current
workflow: Official notices and confirmed calls -> changed service/contact draft -> editor-approved dated updates
requiredHumanReview: Editor verifies each change with centre.
implementationBoundary: No publishing unverified scraped claims; retain provenance and corrections.

category: Provider operations, records and quality improvement
title: Summarize service feedback themes
workflow: Consented de-identified feedback -> cluster administrative themes -> reviewed improvement backlog
requiredHumanReview: Quality team checks themes and examples.
implementationBoundary: No patient-level sentiment scores, clinical conclusions or invented impact metrics.

category: Provider operations, records and quality improvement
title: Turn a service complaint into a reviewable case
workflow: Voice complaint -> faithful stated events and requested resolution -> reviewed complaint record
requiredHumanReview: Complainant confirms; advocate investigates.
implementationBoundary: No negligence finding, legal conclusion or unapproved disclosure.

category: Provider operations, records and quality improvement
title: Prepare a pending-records request
workflow: Referral checklist and received metadata -> identify missing documents -> reviewed service request
requiredHumanReview: Coordinator confirms necessity and permission.
implementationBoundary: No automatic record transfer or inference that missing paperwork means absent care.

category: Provider operations, records and quality improvement
title: Index scanned clinical archives
workflow: Legacy scans -> OCR and metadata -> access-controlled searchable archive
requiredHumanReview: Staff checks patient linkage and extraction; clinician verifies clinical use.
implementationBoundary: Do not destroy originals, infer history or train on records without separate authority.

category: Provider operations, records and quality improvement
title: Format a clinician-approved letter
workflow: Completed clinician content -> format and translate draft -> clinician-signed referral/support letter
requiredHumanReview: Clinician checks facts/signs; translator checks meaning.
implementationBoundary: No fabricated certificates, signatures, eligibility statements or diagnoses.

category: Provider operations, records and quality improvement
title: Check patient documents for accessibility problems
workflow: Approved leaflet text/layout -> flag jargon and density -> human editing checklist
requiredHumanReview: Clinical editor approves wording and retained detail.
implementationBoundary: Do not automatically delete warnings or claim measured comprehension from an AI score.

category: Provider operations, records and quality improvement
title: Draft a clinic stock request from staff dictation
workflow: Authorized item/quantity dictation -> catalog structure -> reviewed requisition
requiredHumanReview: Stores officer verifies quantities and procurement approval.
implementationBoundary: No autonomous controlled-drug purchase, substitution or spending; receipt needs actual records.

title: Practice a synthetic serious-illness conversation
workflow: Educator-written fictional scenario -> patient role-play -> transcript for supervisor feedback
requiredHumanReview: Qualified educator reviews scenario and feedback.
implementationBoundary: Synthetic training only; no patient details or certification claim.

title: Practice difficult medical pronunciations
workflow: Approved terminology and fictional utterances -> audio and transcript comparison -> educator-led practice
requiredHumanReview: Bilingual clinician/interpreter judges pronunciation and meaning.
implementationBoundary: No interpreter certification; include negation, numbers and uncertain speech.

title: Create source-based palliative microlearning
workflow: Locally approved curriculum/passages -> draft learning cards/audio scripts -> approved modules
requiredHumanReview: Palliative educator approves each claim.
implementationBoundary: No invented recommendations, unlicensed copying or automatic protocol changes.

title: Transcribe an approved qualitative study interview
workflow: Protocol-consented recording -> transcript in approved environment and reviewed de-identification -> analysis copy
requiredHumanReview: Researchers verify consent, de-identification and fidelity.
implementationBoundary: Institutional data approvals before upload; de-identification is not guaranteed by a prompt.

title: Administer a service-experience questionnaire aloud
workflow: Approved questionnaire/consent -> audio questions and verbatim answers -> confirmed dataset
requiredHumanReview: Researchers approve wording, language validation and protocol.
implementationBoundary: No changing validated questions, inducement or diagnostic conversion.

title: Prepare a clinical-guideline change briefing
workflow: Two actual guideline versions -> cited explicit differences -> committee-reviewed briefing
requiredHumanReview: Specialist committee verifies evidence and decides adoption.
implementationBoundary: No automatic practice recommendation or protocol replacement.

title: Extract a research paper's reported study fields
workflow: Selected full-text paper -> design/population/outcome extraction with locations -> reviewed evidence table
requiredHumanReview: Researcher verifies all fields and limitations.
implementationBoundary: No fabricated citations, pooled efficacy or treatment advice from unverified extraction.

title: Translate participant information for review
workflow: Approved participant-information sheet -> translation retaining risks/rights -> reviewer-approved version
requiredHumanReview: Ethics team and qualified translator approve; human obtains consent.
implementationBoundary: AI cannot obtain consent alone or alter protocol language without approval.

title: Organize community palliative-service needs
workflow: Consented de-identified access interviews -> classify stated barriers -> human-reviewed needs report
requiredHumanReview: Researchers check themes, sampling and privacy.
implementationBoundary: No small-group identity leakage, prevalence estimate or inferred clinical need from convenience data.

title: Build a synthetic clinical-language safety test set
user: Sahara engineering and clinical safety team
workflow: Clinician-authored fictional utterances/gold transcripts -> error evaluation -> stratified report and release gates
requiredHumanReview: Bilingual clinicians verify labels and safety-critical errors.
implementationBoundary: No patient data or generic word-error-rate-as-validation; test dialects, negation, drugs and numbers.
